author: runtime_review
scope: Held-source mutation/caller inventory and conditional process-local receipt proof. This is not a complete candidate patch signoff, executed test, runtime occurrence/frequency claim, adoption, or quality/speed claim.

proof.state: C=fixed positive capacity; E=unique opaque epoch belonging to this buffer instance; A=next-write pointer when E begins; T=number of normally completed adds in E. Receipt (i,E,s) uses the actual insertion index i and successful serial s.
per_receipt_validity_under_same_replay_l: receipt epoch is E by identity; integer s satisfies 1 <= s <= T
self.size == tree.size; 0 <= self.size <= C; 0 <= tree.data_ptr < C; i is in the current live range; tree and buffer capacities agree
proof.induction: Every completed add writes the current next pointer exactly once and advances it once. Thus serial s occupies (A+s-1) mod C; that same slot is next reused at s+C. Age C-1 remains resident; age C is stale. Epoch inequality rejects clear/load/rebind ABA. A pointer consistency check detects some unmediated changes but does not detect an unhooked full-cycle ABA.
proof.complexity: Constant extra epoch/origin/serial state and O(1) validity per receipt. Resolving/validating k episode or lookback receipts is O(k), including existing vector conversion/copy; whole-episode admission is not O(1).
proof.successful_clock: Increment T for every completed add, including legacy callers that do not request a receipt. A receipt is minted/returned while the insertion lock is held, after successful payload/metadata completion and before unlock. Do not reconstruct it from the pointer later.
proof.why_not_adds_total: replay_buffer.py:422 increments _adds_total before conversion, tree movement and payload writes. A prewrite failure can increase this clock without moving the pointer; a partial failure can advance the pointer and alter only some fields. The clock is also retained across destructive operations. It cannot supply the exact successful-serial/pointer invariant or generation identity. A prewrite failed attempt alone can conservatively over-age a token; clear/load ABA and untracked partial mutation are the stronger correctness hazards. Preserve this existing bank staleness clock unchanged.
assumptions: All in-scope ring mutations use the enumerated buffer methods and the same plain replay lock. No unmediated public-array/tree writes, external mmap writer, capacity replacement, or concurrent mutation outside that lock.

Epochs are process-local opaque identities, unique per buffer/reinitialization, never persisted, reconstructed from bare indices, or shared across distinct buffers. Loaded historical rows receive no retroactive ingestion receipts.

Destructive/rebind operations invalidate the old epoch inside the lock before first live mutation; success and error paths re-anchor to the actual final pointer or remain unready/refusing before unlock. Partial add failures invalidate before unlock, issue no receipt and re-raise the original failure. This fences provenance; it does not repair partially corrupted storage.

mutation_inventory.facts: Plain threading.Lock at201, ring arrays209-217 and SumTree219; SumTree.add108-117 advances pointer before caller payload writes. Initialize a new instance epoch before publication; no outer lock is needed for an unpublished constructor.

add holds lock421; attempted clock422; recycled counts440-445; tree.add446; payload447-470; counters471-478; exposure480-481. All successful callers advance the new clock. Catch partial/conversion/exposure failures inside the lock, invalidate before unlock and preserve the exception.
Lock497; tree leaves/pointer/size and eligibility state mutate501-511. Fence before mutation and re-anchor after success/error; keep permanent banks and existing _adds_total behavior.

Early metadata validation/returns precede live mutation. Lock1845; sequential array rebind1865 and _mmap_dir1873 can fail partway. Fence before the first locked rebind, and again/re-anchor on every exit while still locked.
Lock1904; per-field allocation/copy/rebind1912, _mmap_dir1923. Even a logically identical successful copy is conservatively a new epoch. Partial rebinding must not preserve old tokens.

Maps/validates candidate files before lock1962; live array rebind1967, tree replacement1969 and restored pointer1971. Fence before rebind, not merely after; final anchor must use restored actual pointer, not the old pointer. Do not issue receipts for imported rows.

Initial shape/size validation precedes mutation. Lock2048; bulk payload2055-2074; tree size/pointer2079-2080; totals/eligibility2096-2101. Fence before bulk writes and on partial-error/success completion.
Lock2223; tree replacement2227, size/caches2228-2235 and all payload fills2236-2244. Fence before first mutation and re-anchor on every exit. This method is not a persistence-only flush.

_load_directory1765, _load_npz2001 and load2186 dispatch to adoption/restore and optionally promotion. Fence the actual mutating methods, including direct callers; an outer load-only fence misses them. agent.py:1585 load failures can be caught by the caller.

mutation_inventory.case: same occupant priority / reward / eligibility edits
mutation_inventory.facts: update_priorities lock1089/tree write1104; boost lock1124/write1132; pre-death penalty lock1151/reward write1190; mark_interesting lock1218/label writes1239-1241. These edit the same occupant, so do not advance occupancy serial or epoch. Receipt-bearing callbacks must validate and perform the relevant read/write within this same method lock.

Sanitation writes labels2122/2164/2166 and rebuild2173; these run within the enclosing bulk-load mutation fence. _interesting_bank is a current-eligibility index cache; sampling513-538 rechecks current bounds and label. Do not mistake it for historical episode provenance.

_load_bank lock1615 changes permanent bank arrays/metadata, not ring occupants. save1652 and _flush_live_mmaps_locked412 persist/copy/flush existing live storage; they do not replace it. Neither ordinary bank load nor persistence-only flush requires a ring-occupancy epoch bump. Keep independent bank revision/load epochs and on-disk formats.

atomic_delayed_callbacks.agent_return_race: agent.py:1076/1079 calls memory.add, then1083 derives pointer-1 after the add lock has been released. A concurrent add can change that pointer. The opt-in API must receive (actual idx,epoch,serial) from the insertion transaction. Preserve legacy add return None and legacy agent.step integer behavior; no second insertion/fallback retry.
atomic_delayed_callbacks.plain_lock: replay_buffer.py:201 is threading.Lock, not an RLock despite the class docstring. Never hold it then call a public method that acquires it again. Resolve receipts through a locked helper within each original locking method.
atomic_delayed_callbacks.whole_bank_admission: _bank_admit564 takes lock585. Keep recent score offers587 even when refusing, but validate the complete supplied episode before _bank_span594, bank episode counters610 or copied payload638-646. Reject all on stale/unknown/incomplete input; filtering the surviving subset cannot certify a whole episode. HOF671 and EpHOF763 are separate admissions.
atomic_delayed_callbacks.elite_actor_kind: socket_server.py:878-883 reads current actor_kind under mem.lock to decide learner fraction. Receipt resolution and the actor-kind copy must be in that same lock; a separate prior check followed by unlocked bare-index use is insufficient.
atomic_delayed_callbacks.other_delayed_mutators: Pre-death reward/priority callbacks800-816 and elite priority/interesting callbacks911-912 need independent atomic validation inside each actual buffer lock. A validation in one callback does not authorize a later callback after unlock. Preserve score/level statistics847-848 and FIFO history clearing, including refusal/error paths.

history_and_shutdown.bounded_history: socket_server.py:775-786 stores per-client lookback and episode deques; episode maxlen65536 does not prove residency under global writes from all actors. Detect prefix eviction, insertion failure/unknown receipt, and epoch changes with an existing prefix as incompleteness. Whole-bank admission requires a known complete segment with every receipt resident; bounded tail eligibility has a separately declared scope.
history_and_shutdown.reset: FIFO reset_client791-794 removes both histories before acknowledging. Clear/discard must reset epoch/completeness consistently; legacy/unknown lists or deques must refuse safely and still clear without assuming added attributes.
history_and_shutdown.held_stop_defect: Held stop921 sets running False then drains while the worker may still process its prefetched batch, and drain steps call agent.step without history recording; join is only after the drain at941. Thus held shutdown does not prove one-consumer FIFO or complete tracked episodes.
history_and_shutdown.proposal_stop_scope: Related b120 proposal adds a stop-only lock, joins the consumer before caller drain, refuses to drain if the worker remains alive, and shares recorded-step handling between normal consumption and drain. This addresses concurrent consumers and missing drain bookkeeping. It does not establish producer quiescence.
history_and_shutdown.late_producer_limit: _enqueue_preserving724-730 checks running before queue.put(timeout=.1). A producer already inside put can publish after stop flips running False, possibly after the drain observes empty. SocketServer.stop2686 sets shutdown and stops inference/replay but does not join client producer threads first; accept-loop finally2684, main.py:324 and1264 can request stop. A stop-only lock serializes stop callers, not publication. No assertion that every previously attempted enqueue was drained, acknowledged, or recorded is justified without a separate producer/publication fence. That queue redesign is outside this proof and the approved narrow proposal.

explicit_separate_scope.sample_to_PER: training.py:212 samples ring indices (or takes prefetched data), does GPU work, then544/547 updates priorities with bare indices. prefetch.py:236-247 can extend that delay. Ingestion/episode receipts do not fix this delayed ordinary sample-to-PER path. It remains a separate, explicitly excluded issue; do not widen training/prefetch ABI without selection.
explicit_separate_scope.diagnostic_capture_id: sample_with_metadata819 documents diagnostic capture_id; it is not a persisted row-generation identity or an optimizer/ingestion receipt.
explicit_separate_scope.unmediated_mutation: Public arrays/tree and externally writable mmap storage permit writes outside these hooks. Source searches found no such production write in the listed agent/socket/main/training/prefetch callers; tests do direct writes. The proof assumes their absence and cannot detect arbitrary direct payload edits or an unhooked full pointer cycle.
explicit_separate_scope.noninterference: Do not repurpose _adds_total, ReplayInsertExposure counts/epochs, bank revision/load clocks, checkpoint/bank/ring formats, sampling RNG/quotas, rewards, optimizer/Adam/scaler/schedules or wire/API schemas. learning_exposure.py:28-71 counts normally completed adds under replay.lock and is distinct from row-occupancy receipts. New metadata fences alone prove no runtime benefit.
